metadata.description: V2 head blob (HEAD /blobs/{blobId}), live-captured via mock-capture against the 26.2.0.0 test tenant, 2026-07-30, immediately after upload/get, before delete. 200, empty body, Content-Type application/octet-stream -- unlike GET, HEAD has no response body so the generated method's nil out-param avoids the json.Unmarshal-on-raw-bytes issue documented on the GET fixture; this op works cleanly as generated.
